result.instructions: Tools for SimpleAMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my clients have a policy renewing in the next 30 days?"; "Create a new lead for Jane Smith from the spring campaign and assign it to agent 12."; "Show the commission transactions for carrier 5 from last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SimpleAMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simpleams_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simpleams_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simpleams_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simpleams_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simpleams_get_me
tools.title: Check the API key
tools.description: Show the user the API key belongs to and the key's permissions. Use it first to confirm the key works. SimpleAMS API: GET /me.

tools.name: simpleams_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients the key can see, with optional search and filters. Social Security numbers are never returned. SimpleAMS API: GET /clients.

tools.name: simpleams_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client, including phones, addresses and dependents. SimpleAMS API: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client. Required: first_name, last_name, client_type. Add other fields in fields. Creating runs the same audit, notification and webhook steps as the app. SimpleAMS API: POST /clients.

fields.description: Other fields, named as the SimpleAMS API names them (same rules as the app forms).

tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update a client. Send only the fields to change in fields; other fields keep their values. SimpleAMS API: PUT /clients/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents with optional filters: collection, search, and the record they attach to (related_type and related_id). SimpleAMS API: GET /documents.

tools.name: simpleams_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get the details of one document (name, type, size, the record it attaches to). SimpleAMS API: GET /documents/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_download_document
tools.title: Download a document
tools.description: Download one document. Returns the content as base64 when it is at most 32768 bytes; larger files must be downloaded in the app. SimpleAMS API: GET /documents/{id}/download.

tools.name: simpleams_upload_document
tools.title: Upload a document
tools.description: Attach a file to a client, policy, lead or carrier. Send the file as base64 in content_base64 (10 MB maximum). Allowed types: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt, csv, jpg, jpeg, png. policy_id is allowed only when uploading to a client. SimpleAMS API: POST /{type}/{id}/documents.

file_name.description: File name with extension, for example application.pdf.

tools.name: simpleams_list_commissions
tools.title: List commission transactions
tools.description: List commission transactions (read-only) with filters for agent, carrier, policy, type, status, source and date range. SimpleAMS API: GET /commissions.

tools.name: simpleams_get_commission
tools.title: Get a commission transaction
tools.description: Get one commission transaction (read-only). SimpleAMS API: GET /commissions/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_import_commission_statement
tools.title: Import a commission statement
tools.description: Import a carrier commission statement with all its lines in one call. The statement arrives as Pending Review with unmatched lines; the user runs Auto-Match in the app. At most 700 lines per call. The key's user needs the Import Commission Statements permission. SimpleAMS API: POST /commission-statements.

amount.description: Commission amount. Negative for a chargeback.
